records.title: GOVERNOR'S PARK MOBILITY FEE CREDIT AGREEMENT
records.notes: Executed 2025-10-28 between Clay County and Governors Park Property Holdings, LLC ("GPPH", a Delaware LLC, successor to D.D.I., Inc.), replacing a 2019 predecessor road-impact-fee-credit agreement. GPPH must construct/dedicate the ~5-mile, four-lane Green Cove Springs (GCS) Bypass as a Designated Mobility Improvement under the Governors Park DRI Development Order and Clay County Mobility Fee Ordinance No. 2020-39. County valuation of the GCS Bypass as of 10/1/2025, adjusted for the updated alignment: $81,138,270.20 — this is the MAXIMUM total mobility-fee credit GPPH can earn for the full bypass, not a cash payment and not a credit already earned or used. Credit is earned incrementally (10% upon platting each ROW segment, the remaining 90% upon bonding/completing that segment) and can only be applied dollar-for-dollar against GPPH's/successors' own future Mobility Fee obligations within the DRI (or, with compliance conditions, the adjacent Agricola PUD) — it is not disbursed as cash to GPPH. No annual report or ledger entry evidencing credit actually issued or used has been reviewed. See GOVERNORS_PARK_MOBILITY_FEE_CREDITS.md for full detail, entity-identity caveats (do not conflate GPPH/BTI Partners with the separate "Clay Dair Property Holdings"/"GBAR ranch land" DRI-expansion lead), and the related Cathedral Oak/Reinhold mobility-fee-credit agreement.

records.title: AVAAP AMS LIFELINE SUPPORT
records.notes: Procured via ESC Region 19 Allied States Cooperative (ASC) cooperative-purchasing program, Contract No. 25-7516 — NOT a competitively bid Clay County RFP. SOW #1 of the "Clay County AMS Renewal 2025-2026" project, term 10/1/2025-9/30/2026, T&M not-to-exceed: 900 hrs ceiling (825 hrs AMS Consultant @ $195/hr + 75 hrs Engagement Manager @ $220/hr) = $177,375 original ceiling. Signed 12/12/2025 by Howard Wanamaker (County Manager) and Steve Csuka (CEO, Avaap USA LLC). Reduced to $114,915 by amendment 2025/2026-52 AM1 (see that record). Prior SOWs found in Clerk search but not reviewed this pass: 2022/2023-0014 (10/17/2022) and 2024/2025-0013 (10/15/2024) — a recurring, multi-year relationship. Cross-referenced against data/supplier-invoices.json (PRR-2026-1194): supplier "Avaap USA LLC", 8 invoices, $23,392.76 Approved, -$36,164.54 Canceled, 4 POs, invoice dates 2024-10-31 through 2026-04-30 (spans both this SOW and its 2024 predecessor). Approved-invoice value is well under the current $114,915 ceiling, which is expected and unremarkable for an open, usage-based T&M contract — not a finding of anything irregular. "Approved" is Workday's payment-processing status, not confirmation that funds were disbursed.
